Accession MINI-0001 -- R/V Example, cruise EX24-01, March 2024.

0-about/        This file.
1-ctd/          Shipboard CTD downcasts. Position and UTC time are in each file header.
2-adcp/         Hull-mounted ADCP underway current velocities.
3-ctd-sidecar/  CTD casts from the second leg. The cast table carries no position;
                positions and times are in stations.csv, keyed by station.
4-nutrients/    Nutrient bottle samples. Samples were shipped but never analysed.
